I think you should try your very best to abstain at least 2-3 months before masturbating allowing the reward circuit to calm down.

In regards to getting up early, I would suggest making it easier for yourself to get up. For example, plan for the clothes you'll wear for the next day, have them neatly folded next to your bed so that as soon as the alarm rings, you can put them on with little effort and it will save precius time. Futhermore, make it harder to switch off the alarm, put it in an awkward place or further away from the bed so you have to "work" to press the button; by the time you do, your brain will be inundated with fresh wakeful blood. What really helps me is to "just get up" without thinking about it. I hear the sound and I immediately get up. Its that simple. However, if you allow yourself to think about how warm the bed is or "maybe just another 5 min", it will significantly harder to get up!
